data.name: RTE001_What
data.value: Divide error: division by zero or quotient overflow

data.name: RTE001_Next
data.value: Ensure the divisor is non-zero and that the quotient fits within the destination register.

data.name: RTE002_What
data.value: Single-step trap (INT 1)

data.name: RTE002_Next
data.value: Clear the Trap Flag (TF) in FLAGS or install a custom INT 01h handler.

data.name: RTE003_What
data.value: Non-maskable interrupt (INT 2)

data.name: RTE003_Next
data.value: Install a custom INT 02h handler or check hardware interrupt conditions.

data.name: RTE004_What
data.value: Breakpoint interrupt (INT 3)

data.name: RTE004_Next
data.value: Install a custom INT 03h handler or remove the breakpoint instruction (0xCC).

data.name: RTE005_What
data.value: Overflow trap (INTO with OF=1)

data.name: RTE005_Next
data.value: Install a custom INT 04h handler or check preceding arithmetic operations for signed overflow.

data.name: RTE000_What
data.value: CPU exception (INT {0:X2}h)

data.name: RTE000_Next
data.value: Install a custom INT {0:X2}h vector handler.

data.name: RTE021_What
data.value: INT 21h function {0:X2}h (AH={0:X2}h) is unsupported

data.name: RTE021_Next
data.value: Host file, device, process and network services are not available in the offline emulator (NFR-013). Use supported DOS functions (01h, 02h, 07h, 08h, 09h, 0Ah, 4Ch).

data.name: RTE020_What
data.value: INT {0:X2}h function {1:X2}h (AH={1:X2}h) is unsupported

data.name: RTE020_Next
data.value: Install a program vector for INT {0:X2}h or use supported DOS services (INT 20h, INT 21h).

data.name: RTE010_What
data.value: Unsupported instruction (bytes at CS:IP: {0})

data.name: RTE010_Next
data.value: This instruction is outside the supported 8086 set. See Help for the supported instructions, change the code, then Reset.

data.name: RTE011_What
data.value: The program executed HLT and the CPU stopped

data.name: RTE011_Next
data.value: End the program with INT 21h function 4Ch instead of HLT, then Reset.

data.name: RTE090_What
data.value: Internal emulator error ({0})

data.name: RTE090_Where
data.value: in the emulator, not in your program

data.name: RTE090_Next
data.value: Reset to try again. The log has the details (Help ▸ About ▸ Diagnostics).
